_purpose: Build-side package overlay for the v1.1 rebuild (2026-11-06). build-manifest.json is owned by the orchestrator and still says package 1.0; the generators of the rebuilt artifacts (CCG, WTC, RSPEC, DD, SIR) read this file after the manifest and take package.version / issue_date and the Version Control change-log rows from it. Delete or bump it when the manifest itself is bumped. PSL and DESIGN are not rebuilt in v1.1.
why: Per-state validation pilot: oracle comparison + gap closures.

CCG: FED: pre-2020 Form W-4 filing-status mapping; business mileage rate split at 2026-07-01; tax-year 2027 indexation (Rev. Proc. 2026-35); US-Romania totalization agreement in force from 2026-09-01; ministers' FUTA, FMLA eligibility, EO 13706 sick-leave accrual, employer PFML top-up, back pay, student-loan payments and adjustment procedure stated from their sources (modules 4 to 12 and Annex FED)

CA: DE 9C file formats, WARN threshold, child-support fee, prevailing wage, agricultural overtime and UI coverage rows added; Method B annual payroll and proration recorded as an open Design choice; AB 781 (HSA conformity) shown as a historical source, not in force

TX: UI report due dates, UI wage definition, new-hire contractors, jury and military leave; Labor Code 204.0025 enhanced wage-report fields shown as proposed only (40 TAC 815.107 proposal), not in force and not configured as mandatory

NY: Method II per-period withholding tables (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly, daily and annual allowances and rate tables) for New York State and New York City, Method III rates and Yonkers tables added; Paid Family Leave calendar-year accumulator; quarterly and semiannual payrolls follow the publication's Conversion of Tables rule (monthly table, factor 3 for quarterly and 6 for semiannual); paycard, pay statement, garnishment, NYS-45, NYC flexible-benefit add-back and termination-notice rows added; Method II rounding convention left open
FL: reemployment tax XML package 2026 dated 2026-09-28 (Table 11.1.1 and Annex FL); ch. 2026-52 in force

GA: withholding split into two periods (Table E to 2026-05-10, current method from 2026-05-11, withholding rate tagged to the withholding parameter); UI wage-report electronic filing required for all employers from 2026-08-09 (Table 11.1.1); minimum wage exemptions and family-care leave status
IL: statutory income tax rate, pay-statement content, UI separation notice, SSN display, Chicago tipped wage, Cook County paid leave rules, UI wage base 2027
MI: agricultural and domestic UI coverage, support-order remittance, 2026 PA 39 cited for the tips and overtime deduction (assessment level only; modules 4, 6 and 13 and Annex MI)
NC: UI wage base derivation and registration, W-2 file format, other leave, separation notice, support-order payor duties, data breach, student-learner wage
OH: payment timing, UI wage base not indexed, garnishment priority, certified payroll, no State PFML or TDI programme

PA: payment method, Philadelphia sick leave accrual, HSA withholding, local EIT base, certified payroll, support orders, minimum wage bill status, child labour; H-2A voluntary withholding recorded as an open Design choice
WI: opportunity-employee tipped cash wage and per-meal credit added as their own parameter rows
Effective dates: parameter rows of CA, FL, IL, MI, NC, NY, OH, PA and TX re-dated to the effective date shown by their source

Open points in the modules and in every State annex: limitations and source notes restated in deliverable language (an unverified point reads 'not verified against the official source'); no figure changed by this restatement
WTC: FED (global baseline): business mileage rate split at 2026-07-01 (code 62500); tax-year 2027 parking and transportation exclusion limits (codes 21810 and 62520) and 2027 health FSA salary-reduction cap (code 62610) added next to the 2026 values
CA: SDI employee rate 2027 cites its own source US-CAV6-002 (US-170)
DC: supplemental-wage rule marked as resting on a historical source edition, not confirmed in force (US-080)
GA: withholding standard deduction and dependent allowance split at 2026-05-11 (US-082)

Open points restated in deliverable language, no figure changed: ID, UT, LA, MA, MT, NE and NY withholding rows, AL, HI, IN, MA, TN, TX and VA UI rows, CO FAMLI row, Oregon transit rows and Michigan city tax rows (US-085, US-090, US-091, US-098, US-101, US-104, US-111, US-117, US-127, US-131, US-135, US-158, US-159, US-161, US-171, US-208 to US-210, US-218, US-219)
